155.text: In faith, the human intellect and will co-operate with divine grace: 'Believing is an act of the intellect assenting to the divine truth by command of the will moved by God through grace.'
155.notes: quotes St. Thomas, STh II-II 2, 9 | earlier cached text differed: "In faith, the human intellect and will co-operate with divine grace: \"Believing is an act of the intellect assenting to the divine truth by command of the will moved by God through grace.\""
